package.name: sentinel_bringup
package.description: Autoware Sentinel bringup — declarative topology for the safety island. RFC-0025 Path A package: package.xml + system.toml + launch/ only, no build file. The launch file is the single source of truth for the per-node parameter defaults (mirrored today by autoware_sentinel_core::params::declare_parameters; the 14.4b declarative node wrappers will consume it directly).
